chapter: Henderson, Lester and the bands breaking up
title: Lester Young afraid to join Fletcher Henderson
summary: Herschel stays with Moten, Lester leaves for Henderson, and Tate counsels him.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So Herschel said, "Well, I'm not going to follow Basie everywhere because hell, nobody don't know nothing about him." So he stayed there with Bennie Moten and he and Lester swapped jobs. So when Lester come down there, he was leaving to join Fletcher in Detroit. So they needed a tenor. So when I joined Basie's band, I replaced him then. And he didn't want to go, Gary. He didn't. He says, "Tate, I don't know." He says, "Man, in New York, they got so many cliques." He says, "I can read the charts," he says, "I'm not afraid of that." He says, "But it's more to it than that in New York, they say."

I says, "Well, he chose you. He must know who he wants." I said, "He didn't take Ben, he didn't take Herschel, so he must know who he wants." So he says, "Yeah, but --" I says, "And besides, you can always come back." So he says, "That's the part. That's the hurting part." He says, "The hurting part is to go and don't make it and come back and face the fellas when you don't make it," he says. "That's the part I'm afraid of."
